newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy falls further late on broad-based selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy falls further late on broad-based selling.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures fell to the day's lows in late trading on broad-based fund selling, hitting sell-stops that kicked January into fast trading, traders said.
Fundamentals were little changed. The market was hit early by the posting of heavier than expected deliveries on the November contract amid weak stoppers, the traders said.
Trading in January remained fast as of 1243 CST and sell-stops were hit in that month at $6.79, they said.
At 1244 CST, soybeans were 10 to 14 cents per bushel lower, with November down 12-1/2 at $6.77.
